page.layout: No printed text block. Front cover of a vellum binding: central panel with a small tooled figure scene and a short label beneath it, a decorative frame with small tooled labels along the side borders, and a fragment of lettering at the upper right edge of the spine. Ties at the left edge.
page.notes: Binding, not a printed leaf. The tooled labels in the side borders and the small lettering beneath the central panel are too small and too faint in this scan to read reliably, so they are not transcribed. The spine fragment at upper right is cut off by the edge of the image and cannot be read. Left out: the Herzog August Bibliothek scale bar and caption, and the digitisation footer.
